name: FDM-Monster
description: 3D printer farm management platform for local or in-cloud usage using OctoPrint, Moonraker, PrusaLink and Bambu Lab.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Temporary gcode uploads, UI bundle ZIPs, current UI bundle and logs for FDM Monster. These files are not crucial for FDM Monster to start.

paths.name: Database Path
paths.description: The folder in which the SQLite database files will be stored. There will be more than 1 file (usually around 3 with .sqlite and .wal extensions)

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Port needed to access WebUI of FDM-Monster
